description: Fetch a paid URL. If the site asks for payment (HTTP 402), pay automatically in NGT on Base only when the price is at or under your per-request cap and session budget. Returns the response (JSON, or text cut to the first 50,000 characters) plus amount paid, seller wallet and Base transaction. Host headers from NGT_HOST_HEADERS are added for you; you cannot set or see them. Each call spends real NGT; do not call in a loop. On failure, follow the next step in the error.

max_price_ngt.description: Most to pay for this call, in NGT. Cannot exceed the server cap of 0.01 NGT.

max_price_usdc.description: Ignored: the user has not turned USDC on, so this server pays only NGT.

name: pay_and_fetch
title: Pay and Fetch [Paid: NGT, capped]
